rationale: AEP Indiana Michigan Transmission Company, Inc. is a distinct FERC-regulated transmission operating company. Midwest Transmission Holdings directly owns it; AEP retains 80.1% of Midwest and the KKR/PSP 50/50 Olympus partnership owns 19.9%, producing 9.95% look-through interests for KKR and PSP from the June 5, 2025 closing.
recommendedChanges: Create one canonical AEP Indiana Michigan Transmission Company, Inc. company and retain AEP Ohio Transmission Company as a separate PortCo.
Record AEP as an active 80.1% look-through owner from the June 5, 2025 closing.
Record KKR and PSP Investments as active 9.95% look-through co-owners through Olympus BidCo L.P. from June 5, 2025.
Preserve the December 30, 2024 internal contribution to Midwest Transmission Holdings and do not count Midwest or Olympus as separate PortCos.
Do not infer PSP's internal account or allocate stakes among the four named KKR funds.
unresolvedQuestions: PSP's internal account, allocations among the four KKR funds and AEPTCo's exact direct-owner start date are not publicly disclosed.
Exact FERC and CFIUS clearance dates were not located, although the closing confirms the conditions were satisfied or waived.
